atoms.b: Clara wants to write a letter to her mum back at home. She tries to remember everything she learnt about Siena.

instruction.text: Read Clara’s letter and select the sentences that are not correct.
instruction.sound: Reed Clara’s letter and select the sentences that are not correct.

atoms.a: Dear Mum, let me tell you about the city of Siena. Siena is a city in Mexico. It is a very old city with many old buildings. For example, there is a beautiful square in the middle of the city which is over 700 years old.
atoms.b:
Dear_Mum,
Let_me_tell_you_about_the_city_of_Siena. ((Siena is a city in Mexico.)) It_is_a_very_old_city_with_many_old_buildings. For_example,_there_is_a_beautiful_square_in_the_middle_of_the_city_which_is_over_700_years_old.

atoms.a: ssml: And guess what? Siena has a lot of different neighbourhoods. All of them are named after a planet in the universe. Additionally, every neighbourhood has its own flag with bright colours.
atoms.b: And_guess_what! Siena_has_a_lot_of_different_neighbourhoods. ((All of them are named after a planet in the universe.)) Additionally,_every_neighbourhood_has_its_own_flag_with_bright_colours.

correct.text: Some neighbourhoods are named after animals, while others are named after objects.

atoms.a: ssml: Once a year, there is an elephant race called Palio. Many people from Siena come together at the main square of the city in order to watch the race. Sending lots of love, Clara.
atoms.b:

correct.text: It is not an elephant race but a horse race.
